name: PULIHARA
legalName: Persatuan Pemuliharaan dan Kajian Marin Malaysia (Marine Conservation and Research Organisation Malaysia)
summary: Protects sea turtle eggs and nesting females on Terengganu beaches from poaching and predators, alongside reef restoration and marine research.
programmes: Sea turtle beach patrols and hatcheries at Lang Tengah, Tanjong Jara and Chakar Hutan
Volunteer night patrols and nest monitoring
impact: 264,302 turtle eggs safeguarded and 208,657 hatched (LTTW cumulative through 2024)
405 corals out-planted and 19,753 kg of rubbish removed (cumulative through 2024)
Tanjong Jara 2025: 61 nests and 5,276 eggs saved, 4,170 hatchlings released
beneficiaries: Green and hawksbill sea turtles and painted terrapins in Terengganu; coastal communities

organisation.founded: 2023 (PULIHARA registered 13 Dec 2023; predecessor Lang Tengah Turtle Watch founded 2013)
organisation.founders: Hayati Mokhtar and Raphe van Zevenbergen (founders of Lang Tengah Turtle Watch)
organisation.leadership: Rahayu Zulkifli, Chairperson and CEO; Hiew Wai Phang, Deputy Chairperson; Abidah Zaaba, Secretary; Preetha Sankar, Treasurer

taxExemption.statement: Not stated (site says conservation arm moved under PULIHARA to gain tax exemption; no approval reference printed)

organisation.accounts: Annual (programme) reports per site 2013-2025 public, e.g. 2025 Tanjong Jara: https://puliharamalaysia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/TJ-Annual-Report-2025.pdf; audited financial statements not public
